# Sudirman — Beyond the Ordinary

> Official personal website of Sudirman, an Indonesian independent builder documenting practical work and ongoing exploration in technology, AI, digital systems, automation, and independent business ideas.

Canonical website: https://sudirman.eu.org/

## Main pages
- Homepage: https://sudirman.eu.org/
- About Sudirman: https://sudirman.eu.org/about.html
- Projects and case studies: https://sudirman.eu.org/projects.html
- AI and digital systems: https://sudirman.eu.org/ai.html
- Ideas, technology, and independent systems: https://sudirman.eu.org/ideas.html

## Topics
- Personal AI assistants and AI companion concepts
- AI evaluation and decision support
- Web development and digital identity
- Computer networking, IT, and practical technical support
- Workflow automation and digital systems
- Independent business models and practical experiments

## Context and accuracy
This site documents the owner's interests, experience, projects, and explorations. Ideas and experiments should not be treated as completed products unless a page explicitly says they are complete. Verify time-sensitive details with the relevant page.
